city.title: Stockholm
city.eraIntro.viking: Note: this isn't Stockholm yet. The city is first mentioned in writing in 1252. This is the Mälaren region and the trading post of Birka, about 30 km from where the city will grow.
city.eraIntro.future: These four eras are guesswork, not history. The six before them are documented; this one is an informed guess about where Stockholm might go — some of it built on real announced projects, some of it invented outright.
